evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big cube body, medium posts/rails/planks with deep dark gaps, small chamfered steel corner caps at all 8 corners.
evidence.V3: Confident chunky stylised crate: thick planks with wide shadow gaps, oversized chamfered caps; dims 2.36x2.30x2.33 studs, symmetric (A15 X/Y error 0.0).
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers on planks, posts, rails and caps catch a light rim in the studio close-ups; no razor edges or blobby rounding.
evidence.V5: Close-ups (corner, planks, studio + flat) show flat, clean shading with no pinches, seams, z-fighting or stray faceting; A17/A18 pass, 0 flipped faces, 0 cap overlaps.
evidence.V6: One wood hue in ~3 values (light/dark alternating lid planks, mid sides, darker gaps) plus steel-grey caps; colourways (walnut, teal) keep the same discipline.

evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, wood hue + kit steel grey, ~0.045-stud style chamfers, smooth shading; visually indistinguishable from kit crates.
